key_highlights: ASX 200 closed a volatile week higher, supported by mining and select tech names, but housing-sector weakness capped gains
Housing market under severe stress: auction sentiment deteriorating, values facing a 'perfect storm' of high rates and falling demand; RBA flags persistent housing inflation as a policy constraint
Pilbara iron ore production surging ('Pilbara killer booms'), supporting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings trajectory
Gateway Resources (GAT.AX) discovered 7km gold trend in WA, adding to junior gold exploration momentum
Global tech volatility: Salesforce +23% breaks 'SaaSpocalypse' trade; PayPal hit after Stripe/Advent drop $53B takeover; Nvidia locks $279B memory-chip bet
Trump-Venezuela oil deal introduces supply-side uncertainty for energy sector; Hanson pushes coal-heavy energy policy
Consumer data shows strong weight-loss drug demand, 'dupe' brand shift, and accelerating EV uptake; childcare sector in structural distress
Virgin Australia (QAN.AX) insulated from oil shock via fuel hedging and new fleet; Qantas (QAN.AX) workforce issues persist

sectors.trend: Positive. Pilbara iron ore output surging; Gateway WA gold discovery; ASX small-caps Metal Hawk and Bapcor among weekly runners. Commodity backdrop supportive.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from volume growth. Junior gold (GAT.AX) and base-metal explorers attract speculative flows. Watch iron ore pricing vs. China demand.

sectors.trend: Cautious. Housing 'perfect storm' and auction sentiment deterioration raise NPL concerns. RBA constrained by housing inflation, limiting rate-cut flexibility.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds rates. Credit cycles for property-backed lending under scrutiny. REITs (VGP.AX, DGP.AX) under valuation pressure.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Trump-Venezuela oil deal adds supply uncertainty. Hanson's coal-heavy policy favours traditional energy. Data-centre fossil-fuel demand creates structural tailwind for gas.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, SXG.AX, AWE.AX benefit from policy support. Oil price volatility a double-edged sword for downstream. Watch LNG contract renewals.

sectors.trend: Divergent. Weight-loss drug demand and EV uptake positive for CSL.AX, WES.AX. 'Dupe' brand trend pressures premium consumer names. Childcare sector in structural crisis.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX benefit from healthcare demand. WES.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from value-shift. Childcare operators (CPT.AX) face revenue contraction.

sectors.trend: Volatile but constructive. Salesforce +23% signals SaaS recovery. Nvidia $279B memory bet, Bitcoin rally, PayPal/Stripe deal collapse create mixed signals.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) may see sentiment spillover. Data-centre buildout supports Australian infrastructure and power names. Monitor global risk appetite.

sectors.trend: Resilient. Virgin hedged against oil shock; Qantas workforce issues unresolved. New fleet deployments support capacity.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (Virgin) better positioned than Qantas (QAN.AX) on cost structure. Fuel hedging a key differentiator.

key_themes: Housing market stress as primary macro risk to RBA policy and bank earnings
Commodity super-cycle in iron ore and gold supporting materials sector
Energy policy shift toward coal and fossil-fuel data centres
Global tech volatility with SaaS recovery and AI capex acceleration
Consumer value-shift: dupe brands, weight-loss drugs, EV adoption
Political influence of One Nation on trade, energy, and immigration policy
Fed policy uncertainty ('Will the Fed join the war?') affecting global liquidity

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction / 'perfect storm' in property values
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour banks with diversified loan books; monitor RBA commentary on housing inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy constraint from persistent housing inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Position for prolonged higher-for-longer rates; favour dividend-paying large caps over rate-sensitive growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price volatility from Trump-Venezuela deal
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour integrated majors (WES.AX) over pure-play upstream

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global tech / AI capex cycle reversal
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from single-name tech concentration; monitor Nvidia, Salesforce earnings as leading indicators

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Political policy disruption (One Nation influence on trade, energy, immigration)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor policy shifts affecting coal, renewables, and trade-post structures; avoid over-concentration in policy-sensitive sectors
Avoid childcare operators; monitor for consolidation opportunities

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight iron ore and gold miners on Pilbara volume surge and WA gold discovery
opportunities.rationale: Pilbara output boom supports earnings; Gateway's 7km gold trend validates WA exploration pipeline; small-caps showing relative strength

opportunities.recommendation: Favour integrated energy majors on coal policy support and data-centre power demand
opportunities.rationale: Hanson's coal-heavy policy and fossil-fuel data-centre approvals create structural demand tailwind for gas and coal

opportunities.recommendation: Selective healthcare exposure on weight-loss drug demand
opportunities.rationale: Australian consumer data shows surging GLP-1 demand; CSL and SSW positioned to benefit from domestic and export growth

opportunities.recommendation: Monitor SaaS recovery trade for ASX tech spillover
opportunities.rationale: Salesforce +23% and Nvidia $279B bet signal AI capex cycle intact; Australian tech may lag but benefit

defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'perfect storm', falling auction sentiment, and RBA constraint create downside risk to property valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate sensitivity in bank holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA constrained by housing inflation; prolonged higher rates pressure net interest margins and property loan growth

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as portfolio ballast
defensive_moves.rationale: Volatile week, Fed uncertainty, and housing risk argue for liquidity buffer

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to range-trade with elevated volatility. Housing data and RBA commentary dominate. Mining provides support; REITs and banks drag. Global tech flows (Salesforce, Nvidia, Bitcoin) create episodic upside. Expect 1-2% weekly swings.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA eases 25-50bps by Q1 2027. Iron ore and gold remain structural supports. Housing correction risk is the key swing factor. Energy policy shift toward coal creates a multi-year tailwind for integrated majors. Consumer value-shift reshapes retail landscape.
